details: The model judged whether the quoted sentences support each finding's verdict and rationale.

steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 1 problem in 12 items
details: The Critic objected to the understandable business rationale: it says "It also notes direct-to-consumer sales through Costa retail stores", which the quoted sentences don't show.

steps.title: Critic sent 1 finding back for repair
details: Understandable business: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).

steps.title: Rationale rewrite for understandable business: 344 tokens in, 48 out, ~$0.0002 at paid rates
details: The model saw only the question, the verdict and the quoted sentences, and rewrote the rationale to say no more than they show.

New rationale: The company generates revenue by selling finished sparkling and other beverages to retailers, distributors, and wholesalers. Additionally, it manufactures and sells fountain syrups to fountain retailers, wholesalers, and bottling partners.

steps.title: Critic re-checked the repaired items
details: Only the items that were sent back are checked again.
